name: harness5
description: harness5 packages the cc-harness repository as a single installable plugin for Claude Code and Codex, shipping skills, hooks, and a local infrastructure stack (OpenTelemetry collector, SigNoz) with no duplication across harnesses.

interface.shortDescription: cc-harness skills, hooks, and local infra stack (OTel, SigNoz) for Claude Code and Codex.
interface.longDescription: harness5 is the cc-harness repository packaged as a single installable plugin for both Claude Code and Codex. The same skills/, hooks/, and infrastructure/ tree ships to both harnesses with no duplication. After a fresh install, run the harness5-init skill to scaffold infrastructure/.env from .env.example and bring the docker compose stack (OpenTelemetry collector, SigNoz) up as a shared local instance.
